input_authority: accepted target-dated lifecycle identity binding plus active_security_ids
rules: The target-dated lifecycle active security set is authoritative for the current execution and is unioned into any older or narrower date snapshot.
Every active lifecycle security must resolve to exactly one canonical identity row before owner materialization; missing or duplicate identity is a hard failure.
Every active lifecycle security is retained in Core/Profile status output even when its price history is insufficient.
Missing price history emits field-local UNKNOWN and INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY; no raw bar, adjusted price, or return is fabricated.
Historical dates retain their own dated universes and are not backfilled with current identities.

acceptance.active_lifecycle_ids: exactly equal Core/Profile status security IDs
acceptance.unknown_history: explicit quality codes; price fields remain null
